prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a hidden forgotten village deep in a mossy forest (small bark-clad huts, moss and ferns growing on the roofs). roof so overgrown with thick green moss and small ferns that the shingles barely show walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout-guide image into ONE finished building game sprite, retaining the layout EXACTLY. This is a strict image-to-image pixel-art paintover, not a redesign. Canvas 1232 x 1120 pixels, representing exactly 176 x 160 square art pixels at 7x nearest-neighbor scale. Every pixel must be a sharp identically sized 7x7 square. Full transparent alpha background in place of ALL magenta, with no ground and no shadow. Preserve exact outer silhouette: roof spans x=14 to 1218 and y=196 to 715; front wall spans x=56 to 1176 from y=715 to canvas bottom y=1120. Preserve roof/wall boundary at y=715, and dark eaves/roof division at y=423-437. Roof shown from above in top portion; broad lower portion is the near sloping roof face, not another wall. A single straight-on front log wall below y=715. Maintain exactly ONE small amber window in original position x=350..463 y=896..1037, and ONE walk-through dark-brown door x=553..680 y=938..1120, flush with bottom edge, neither shift, resize nor cover these. Do not create additional windows or doors. Render a one-storey forgotten forest village house: extremely lush thick clustered green moss with small crisp fern sprigs obscuring most roof shingles; walls made of horizontally stacked round brown logs with notched corners. Window divided into small glowing amber panes by dark wooden muntins, maintaining window's original total rectangle and location; this is the ONLY lighting accent. Wooden brown plank door in unchanged location/size and ground-level access, dark inside with a clear frame and tiny subtle handle. Limited details such as tiny eaves and moss fringes, but maintain silhouette. Premium modern high-bit JRPG 3/4 top-down pixel art, sophisticated hand-placed 3–10 art-pixel clusters, crisp square edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no brushwork, no grain, no checkerboard dithering. Hue-shifted rich earthy color ramps with purple/red-leaning saturated shadows and yellow-leaning highlights, 4–6 shades per material. Neutral soft even ambient overcast evening light from upper left, NO cast shadow, NO night darkness, NO pools of light or vignette. Isolated single building only, transparent background, no people, no letters or text.
